issues.description: Users report being unable to sign in with a phone number, including cases where it is rejected despite being correct.
Users say they cannot log in to their account, without identifying a specific sign-in method or error.
Most examples report inability to log in, while one describes playback cutting off mid-song after sign-in troubleshooting.
Users object to limits on song selection and playlist playback, including shuffle behavior and controls that they say require Premium.
issues.issue_name: Playlist playback and song selection limits

issues.description: Users report frequent or intrusive ads interrupting music playback, including complaints that an ad-free option still includes ads.
